gap_register.condition: Expected Rupee Payoff Head on Holdout
gap_register.diagnostic_finding: Payoff regressor loses rank-ordering ability under holdout session macro shifts, failing to filter negative-expectancy trades.
High accuracy in the >70% confidence band is an artifact of extreme sparsity (12 trades across 4 days) and cannot support standalone qualification without prospective scaling.
Formula A turnover friction ($7.0\text{ bps}$) destroys positive gross excursions below threshold, mandating high predictive precision or selective excursion gating.
